requirements_summary: Compliance-sensitive fintech evaluating Redwood primarily for Private (VPC) with strict controls around cost visibility and exports. Must support: (1) RBAC gating for cost views (finance/admin only) and explicit separate permission for CSV export + shareable report links, (2) audit logging for export creation + download with enough fields for SOC/SOX evidence, (3) billing reconciliation: console route/model totals must tie back to invoice totals; Northstar expects documented tolerance, rounding rules, and handling of late telemetry events, (4) data residency and retention: prefer region-scoped aggregation and retention aligned to contract; wants clarity on whether exports are retained server-side or purely generated ad-hoc.
notes:
